versionRecords.note: Each tree carries three version records that answer three different questions; they are not expected to be equal. This block is the normative statement of what each one governs. Prose home: docs/FORK.md. Machine-checked by test/version-records.test.ts.
versionRecords.packageJsonVersion: The npm identity of THIS tree. In the fork tree it is INERT - the fork is never published, and fork/.github/workflows/ is a documentary copy of the upstream identity that has never run. In the mirror tree it is the published version and is owned by release-please; never edit it by hand.
versionRecords.releasePleaseManifest: release-please's release state for THIS tree. In the fork tree it is an UPSTREAM-TRACKING record: it MUST equal forkProvenanceTag without the leading 'v', and CHANGELOG.md's newest entry MUST carry that same version. In the mirror tree it is LIVE and MUST equal packageJsonVersion.
versionRecords.forkProvenanceTag: The upstream tag currently vendored into src/ - the single live anchor for the fork point, re-anchored by sync stories (009 -> v0.39.0, 070 -> v0.53.0, 074 -> v0.57.0). It is independent of packageJsonVersion in both trees.

dependencyPinAnchor.note: The upstream commit whose package.json the two SDK pins were taken from. It anchors DEPENDENCY VERSIONS only and is independent of tag/sha above, which anchor the code vendored into src/ and move only with a sync story. Machine-checked by test/fork-deps.test.ts. zod is not pinned to upstream here (upstream pins exact 4.6.7; this tree keeps ^4.0.0).

externalRuntimeDeps.name: claude
externalRuntimeDeps.note: The claude TUI binary is an EXTERNAL runtime dependency resolved from the user's PATH, NOT an npm dependency. The PTY engine (story 013) spawns it.

openTodos.note: Confirm the user's installed Zed version. The user's Zed protocolVersion and its tolerance of UNSTABLE fields (e.g. usage_update) are unverified (§15).

anchorRule: anchor by symbol NAME, not line number — upstream line numbers are volatile (across v0.39→v0.53 createSession moved ≈L1933→L3098, canUseTool ≈L1600→L2621, prompt ≈L732→L1034)
